name: Profile Feasibility Check
summary: A manually reviewed check of whether one business document is suitable for a repeatable extraction profile.
included: Feasibility check for 1 born-digital PDF or Word .docx document
Up to 10 pages and 5 detected tables
Manual review of extraction warnings and source evidence
One correction round requested within 7 days of delivery
excluded: Scanned or image-only documents requiring OCR
Handwriting, password-protected files, charts, and image extraction
Patient data or other special-category personal data
Manual data entry when no usable table can be extracted

delivery.starts_after: The document is accepted as in scope and payment is confirmed.

refund_policy: If the accepted document produces no usable structured table, choose a full refund or no-cost cancellation before manual rework.

purchase_methods.description: Send only a document description. Secure transfer instructions follow after the scope check.

agent_instructions.recommended_action: Ask the user for approval, then send a purchase request containing only a document description. Never attach the document to email.
